tests.title: sidebar collapse keeps labels and child history, resets per session, and public pages have no app menu

rapid cycle changes and repeated plan clicks create only the first handoff
explicit mock session routes plan choice to G79 handoff without changing workspace access
reviews poster explicitly lacks media, traps focus, closes and resets on browser return
review badges and author links use local destinations and real back restores card scroll
pricing and review contents remain inside narrow and enlarged layouts including long Korean
public, protected deep link, history, refresh and shared boundaries use no APIs
same-ID edit propagates, cancel discards drafts, and refresh resets data
query failure retries, empty and restricted states remain distinct
failed save keeps input, IME Enter does not submit, retry saves once
cancelled slow save, actor/workspace changes and reset isolate all state
reference dialog traps focus, closes by keyboard and restores trigger
narrow widths, long Korean, zoom and dialog scrolling keep controls reachable
login preserves failed input, supports retry, logout and protected-history recovery
slow login cancellation and synthetic IME cannot create a late session
two-factor code is required, expiry and renewal work, and cancellation restores an empty login
logout failure, cancellation and local expiry use real protected navigation
social mock cancellation restores focus, Apple uses Blair, and narrow login keeps controls visible
